name: GitBook
description: GitBook is a documentation platform for building and maintaining technical and product documentation, with tooling to keep docs synced with code and AI features aimed at making docs answerable directly.
best_for: Positioned for teams — across financial services, healthcare, startups, and tech — that need documentation infrastructure with security, access control, and collaboration at scale.
features: Git Sync to branch, review, and merge docs like a pull request
AI Agent that flags stale or outdated content
AI Assistant letting readers ask questions directly of the docs
AI Insights surfacing where readers get stuck

alternatives.name: Confluence
alternatives.description: Atlassian's team workspace for documentation, meeting notes, and internal knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: General team documentation beyond developer docs

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: An all-in-one workspace combining documents, databases, project tracking, and team knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a lighter-weight, more flexible workspace

alternatives.name: Guru
alternatives.description: An enterprise knowledge-management platform that organizes and continuously verifies company information.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprise teams needing verified, permission-scoped knowledge

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: One free user; unlimited page views.

cons: Paid cost combines a per-site fee with a separate $12-per-user monthly collaborator charge, so team size materially changes total cost.
Advanced AI and enterprise controls are tier-gated: Ultimate adds the AI Assistant, while SAML SSO, custom integrations, and dedicated support require Enterprise.
